acv.quote: Two hundred and ten K ACV.

header.reason: Greg, the controller, signed four days after Tobi showed which of their own failed renewals could come back. Only memberships were won. Front desks stay with Global. The rep first credited Maya.

findings.label: What started it
findings.finding: Lead with failed cards hiding inside the churn numbers boards see.

line.text: Monetize faster with Stripe Billing. Manage pricing, reduce churn, and grow revenue on one platform

findings.why: Corelane's board churn rose two quarters, and splitting it showed failed cards were a bigger bucket than expected.
findings.quote: split it into people who cancelled and people whose card just failed

findings.label: Who decided
findings.finding: Show the controller recoverable renewals from his own data, not averages.
findings.why: Greg, the controller, held the contract for two weeks and signed only after seeing his own failed renewals.
findings.quote: Greg hadn't said a word in two meetings, and he asked for the spreadsheet.

findings.label: The competitor
findings.finding: State plainly what leaving the current processor costs, and our contract term.
findings.why: Maya told the rep Global offered a front-desk bundle on a longer contract. Questions then turned to exit costs.
findings.quote: Greg asked about termination fees twice.

findings.label: Our message
findings.finding: Cut the global headline for customers in one or two countries.
findings.why: The rep opened with the global slide and got silence. Corelane has studios in the US and a few in Canada.
findings.quote: I opened with the global slide.

findings.label: Missing proof
findings.finding: Add a live example of our reader inside studio management software.

line.text: Stripe Terminal is a point of sale system that unifies your online and offline channels

findings.why: Maya feared two screens at the front desk. They only saw a partner demo, not their own setup.

findings.label: Their words
findings.finding: Say 'members who never meant to leave' instead of 'failed payment recovery'.

line.text: AI-powered Smart Retries, card account updater, and cancellation surveys work together to keep revenue flowing

findings.why: From earlier in the call: Maya used this phrase for failed-card churn. The words question itself went to Slack.
findings.quote: members who never meant to leave.
